Definition: from the base of G2849; a limb of the body (as if lopped):--carcase.
BiblicalUsage: Kolon is a carcase, a limb lopped off. Hebrews 3:17 asks, was it not with them that had sinned, whose carcases fell in the wilderness, after God was grieved forty years?
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the carcases in the wilderness are the end of unbelief: a whole generation that saw the miracles and would not enter, and fell where they wandered.
